_doc: Cross-practice adjacency groups. 'trigger' is a regex tested on the lowercased work-item query (or on the top candidates' P_Name/SKU). 'members' is a regex tested on P_Name + SKU + Item_Name (+ Description when 'member_fields' includes it). Every matching active row, in any practice, is listed under 'Also consider'. Add a group here when a topic is sold or scoped by more than one practice.
